exam_rules.departmental: Departmental subjects normally use MCQ Mid 1 and Mid 2; no ESE unless explicitly approved.

exam_rules.MCQ: Exactly 30 questions, four options each, answer index 0=A, 1=B, 2=C, 3=D.

exam_rules.theoryESE: 60 marks: two 1-mark questions, one 2-mark question, and 4-/8-mark questions totalling 56; resolve the blueprint if 2-mark questions are prohibited.
exam_rules.retention: One reference test per available subject/exam type; generate requested difficulty at runtime.
